craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at willed-measure — tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor. Wayless-way paradox kept whole (unothered means); they-call close. Rejected: (a) resolving paradox → killed: paradox is the means. Read aloud: WHAT-way, THIS-truth … THEY-call.

lines: What way, this truth — whence no other way may be —
wayless way — this self-way — they call.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kim upāyam idaṃ tattvaṃ yato 'nyan naiva sambhavi | ananyopāyam etat tadātmopāyaṃ pracakṣate

reads_against.argmap: What means needs no other? → Means unothered; self-means called.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of called bound; vīra of followed stations; adbhuta of teeming imagination; śānta of feast-abiding; vātsalya-vīra of bidden beholding; vīra of unothered means
